title: provider.py read URL --grep WORDS reads a page by its route and prints the matching lines, so research locates a passage without WebFetch
goal: provider.py read URL [--grep WORDS] [--context N] fetches the url in its provider's raw form (Learn markdown, the .md form of code.claude.com and modelcontextprotocol.io, a GitHub blob as raw.githubusercontent.com at the same ref, a GitLab blob as /-/raw/, an arXiv abstract through the export API, else the HTML page reduced to text), caches it under _cache/ as factdiff's fetches are, and prints the lines that hold every grep word with line numbers and the url to cite; new providers.csv rows give GitHub blob-to-raw and arXiv their raw forms; a PDF is reported as not text, left to the Read tool; kb-research step 3 and kb/_self/web-sources.md name it as the way to locate a passage, with WebFetch no longer needed for that; the suite tests the url mapping and the grep with stubbed responses.

run: import sys; sys.exit(0 if all('provider.py read' in open(p, encoding='utf-8').read() for p in ('.claude/skills/kb-research/SKILL.md', 'kb/_self/web-sources.md')) else 1)
